passages.text: HDFC Bank lists Amazon, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Flipkart, Myntra, Sony LIV, Swiggy, Tata CLiQ, Uber and Zomato as the card's accelerated cashback merchants.
These ten merchants earn 5% cashback. Other spends earn 1%. Each rate is capped at 1,000 CashPoints per statement cycle.
The joining fee and the renewal fee are each ₹1,000 plus taxes. The renewal fee is waived for the next year if you spend ₹1,00,000 in 12 months.
GST applies on all fees, charges and interest.
One CashPoint is worth ₹1 when redeemed against the statement. At least 500 CashPoints are needed. Statement redemption is capped at 3,000 CashPoints per calendar month.
Fuel, rent, government transactions, cash advances, card fees and Smart EMI or Dial-an-EMI transactions earn no cashback.
The fuel surcharge waiver is 1% on transactions of ₹400 to ₹5,000. It is capped at ₹250 per statement cycle.
Spending ₹1 lakh in a calendar quarter unlocks a choice of one domestic lounge visit or a ₹1,000 brand voucher.
Salaried applicants must be 21 to 40 years old with net monthly income above ₹35,000. Self-employed applicants need ITR above ₹6 lakh a year.
Finance charges are listed at 3.75% per month, or 45% a year.

cards.notes: Fees, the renewal waiver and the merchant list are confirmed on HDFC Bank pages. Cashback rates, caps, exclusions, redemption rules, lounge, eligibility and interest come from Paisabazaar because the issuer product page did not render its details. Older HDFC pages show a different, outdated structure and were not used. Network shown as Visa per Paisabazaar. Other network variants were not confirmed. Forex markup and a current welcome offer could not be confirmed.

passages.text: Online spends at partners such as BookMyShow, Apollo 24X7, Domino's, IGP, Myntra, Yatra, Netmeds, Tata CLiQ and Cleartrip earn 10X points. Other online spends earn 5X. All other spends earn 1 point per ₹100.

Online spends of ₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh in a year each earn a ₹2,000 Cleartrip or Yatra e-voucher.

general.text: A credit card comes with a pre-approved revolving credit limit. It can be used to buy goods and services or to draw cash advances.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: The interest-free period applies only when the cardholder pays the entire outstanding by the payment due date.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Interest can be charged only on the outstanding amount, after adjusting for payments, refunds and reversed transactions.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Statements must be sent in time to leave at least a fortnight to pay before interest starts.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: The minimum amount due must be set so that paying it does not make the balance grow. Unpaid charges, levies and taxes cannot be added to the balance for charging interest.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Statements must warn that paying only the minimum each month stretches repayment over months or years with compounded interest.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: An account can be reported as past due, and late payment charges levied, only when it stays unpaid for more than three days after the due date.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Late payment charges apply only to the outstanding amount after the due date, not to the total amount due.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: A request to close a credit card must be honoured within seven working days once all dues are paid. If the issuer is late, it must pay the cardholder ₹500 for each calendar day of delay.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Issuing unsolicited cards or upgrades is prohibited. If one is issued and billed, the issuer must reverse the charges and pay a penalty of twice their value.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Issuers need written consent, or digital consent with multifactor authentication, before issuing a credit card. They cannot raise the credit limit without explicit consent.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Before reporting a default to a credit information company (a credit bureau), the issuer must inform the cardholder. After the dues are settled, the issuer must update the bureau within 30 days.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: The Most Important Terms and Conditions must state the cash advance fee and the cash withdrawal limit, and show the interest-free period with examples.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: Issuers must give a one-page Key Fact Statement with the card application, covering the interest rate and charges.

source.title: Master Direction, Reserve Bank of India (Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct) Directions, 2022

general.text: A customer has zero liability when an unauthorised electronic transaction arises from the bank's negligence, or from a third-party breach that the customer reports within three working days.

source.title: Customer Protection, Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (RBI, 6 July 2017)

general.text: The bank must credit the disputed amount as a shadow reversal within 10 working days, and resolve the complaint within 90 days.

source.title: Customer Protection, Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (RBI, 6 July 2017)
